A person chose the face they wear beside their name, or went back to their initials. Not sent to a harness.

**Direction:** Chips → the log  
**Sent by:** Chips only; refused from a client  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`person.face_set.json`](/schema/person.face_set.json)
